description: Flutter plugin for passkey (WebAuthn / FIDO2) registration and sign-in on iOS, macOS and Android, with PRF and largeBlob extension support.
rules: Import with `import 'package:flutter_passkey_service/flutter_passkey_service.dart';` and call the static methods on `FlutterPasskeyService`; there is no instance to construct.
Always generate the WebAuthn challenge on the server with a cryptographically secure RNG and verify the returned response on the server. The plugin is client-side only.

When the server already returns WebAuthn JSON (PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions / PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions), use `createRegistrationOptionsFromJson` / `createAuthenticationOptionsFromJson` instead of rebuilding options by hand.
`userId` / `user.id` must be the base64url encoding of the user handle bytes (for example `dXNlci0xMjM`), never a raw string like `user-123`.

`rpId` must exactly equal the domain that hosts `/.well-known/apple-app-site-association` (iOS/macOS) and `/.well-known/assetlinks.json` (Android); otherwise the call fails with `PasskeyErrorType.domainNotAssociated`.
Wrap `register` and `authenticate` in `try { } on PasskeyException catch (e)` and switch on `e.errorType`; treat `userCancelled` and `noCredentialsAvailable` as expected outcomes, not crashes.

PRF key derivation requires iOS 18+ / macOS 15+ / a modern Android passkey provider. Enable it at registration with `enablePrf: true`, then pass a base64url salt via `prfEval: {'first': salt}` at authentication and read `response.clientExtensionResults?.prf?.results?['first']`.

largeBlob requires iOS 17+ / macOS 14+. Enable it with `enableLargeBlob: true` at registration; at authentication pass either `largeBlobRead: true` or `largeBlobWrite: bytes`, never both. The blob is limited to about 1 KB.

Supported platforms are iOS 16+, macOS 13+ and Android API 28+ (library minSdk 23). There is no web, Windows or Linux implementation. Security keys (YubiKey) and conditional UI / autofill are not supported.

Since 0.1.0, `createRegistrationOptionsFromJson` / `createAuthenticationOptionsFromJson` do not inject defaults: `timeout`, `userVerification`, `authenticatorSelection` and credential `transports` stay null when the server omits them. Null-check those fields.
Do not edit generated files (`messages.g.dart`, `Messages.kt`, `Messages.swift`); they come from `lib/pigeons/messages.dart` via Pigeon.
